Sausalito.name: Downtown & Ferry Landing
Sausalito.line: Bridgeway from the ferry dock to Plaza Vina del Mar; Old Town's quiet lanes climb just south.

Sausalito.name: Caledonia Street
Sausalito.line: Sausalito's everyday main street a block inland from Bridgeway, with Dunphy Park on the water below.

Sausalito.name: Marinship & Bay Model
Sausalito.line: WWII shipyard turned marine-industrial district: the Army Corps' Bay Model, boatyards and Heath Ceramics.

Sausalito.name: Waldo Point Houseboats
Sausalito.line: Floating-home docks off Gate 5 and Gate 6 Road, the last of Sausalito's anchor-out bohemia.

Marin City.name: Gateway & Donahue Street
Marin City.line: The flats along Donahue Street by the Highway 101 off-ramp, anchored by the Gateway shopping center.

Marin City.name: Golden Gate Village
Marin City.line: Aaron Green's 1960 public-housing towers and townhomes on the hillside, with ridge trails above.

Mill Valley.name: Miller Avenue & Tam High
Mill Valley.line: The long Miller Avenue corridor from downtown toward Tam Junction, past Tamalpais High and the 2AM Club.

Mill Valley.name: Alto & East Blithedale

Mill Valley.name: Bayfront Park

Mill Valley.name: Cascade Canyon
Mill Valley.line: Redwood-shaded Cascade Drive to Cascade Falls and the Three Wells, under Blithedale Ridge.

Tam Valley.name: Tam Junction
Tam Valley.line: Where Shoreline Highway splits from 101 for the coast; Good Earth and the Buckeye Roadhouse.

Tam Valley.name: Tennessee Valley Road
Tam Valley.line: Tam Valley's ranch houses along Tennessee Valley Road, the back way to the Headlands trailhead.

Tam Valley.name: Homestead Valley
Tam Valley.line: A wooded hollow of its own between Miller Avenue and the ridge, with Stolte Grove and the Homestead trails.

Strawberry.name: Strawberry Village
Strawberry.line: The Redwood Highway shopping center at the Tiburon Boulevard exit; the Strawberry Rec District pool uphill.

Strawberry.name: Seminary Drive
Strawberry.line: The old Baptist seminary hilltop and Strawberry Point beyond, where the spit ends at the seal haul-out.

Tiburon.name: Main Street & Ark Row
Tiburon.line: Ferry landing, waterfront restaurants and the floating-ark cottages of Ark Row along a one-block Main Street.

Tiburon.name: Old St. Hilary's
Tiburon.line: The 1888 Carpenter Gothic church on the hill above town, ringed by a wildflower preserve.

Tiburon.name: Blackie's Pasture
Tiburon.line: The swayback horse's statue marks the start of the Old Rail Trail along Richardson Bay toward downtown.

Tiburon.name: Bel Aire & the Cove
Tiburon.line: The inland neighborhoods off upper Tiburon Boulevard, with the Cove shopping center and Reed School.

Belvedere.name: Belvedere Island
Belvedere.line: Hilltop mansions and Beach Road's yacht clubs on the island facing Sausalito and the Golden Gate.

Belvedere.name: Belvedere Lagoon
Belvedere.line: Low ranch houses and docks around the private lagoon between Belvedere and Tiburon.

Corte Madera.name: Old Corte Madera
Corte Madera.line: Town Park, the library and Tamalpais Drive's small downtown; Christmas Tree Hill's lanes climb behind.

Corte Madera.line: Two open-air malls flanking Highway 101: the Village's Nordstrom and Apple, the Town Center and Book Passage.

Corte Madera.name: Ring Mountain
Corte Madera.line: Serpentine grassland preserve on the Tiburon ridge with petroglyphs and the endemic Tiburon mariposa lily.

Larkspur.name: Downtown Magnolia Avenue
Larkspur.line: Magnolia Avenue's 1900s storefronts, the Lark Theater's neon and redwood-shaded Dolliver Park.

Larkspur.name: Larkspur Landing
Larkspur.line: Golden Gate Ferry terminal, Marin Country Mart and the Richmond bridge approach, with San Quentin next door.

Larkspur.line: Bon Air shopping center and MarinHealth Medical Center on Sir Francis Drake, with Greenbrae's hillside homes.

Larkspur.name: Baltimore Canyon
Larkspur.line: Redwood canyon preserve below King Mountain, with Dawn Falls at the top of Madrone Avenue.

Kentfield.name: College of Marin
Kentfield.line: The community college campus and Kentfield's small Sir Francis Drake commercial strip at College Avenue.

Kentfield.name: Kent Woodlands
Kentfield.line: Large wooded lots climbing toward Mount Tam, with trailheads into Baltimore Canyon and the watershed.

Ross.name: Ross Common
Ross.line: The town green, post office and Marin Art & Garden Center, where Sir Francis Drake bends through Ross.

Ross.name: Phoenix Lake Trailhead
Ross.line: Natalie Coffin Greene Park at the end of Lagunitas Road, the gateway to Phoenix Lake and the Tam watershed.

San Anselmo.name: Downtown & The Hub
San Anselmo.line: San Anselmo Avenue's antique shops and cafes, and the Hub where Sir Francis Drake meets Center Boulevard.

San Anselmo.name: Seminary & Memorial Park
San Anselmo.line: Castle-like stone halls of the old San Francisco Theological Seminary above Memorial Park's ballfields.

San Anselmo.name: Sleepy Hollow
San Anselmo.line: A dead-end valley of 1950s ranch houses along Butterfield Road, with the community center at its heart.

Fairfax.name: Downtown Broadway
Fairfax.line: Broadway and Bolinas Road: Fairfax's hippie-era bars, the Marin Museum of Bicycling and the Fairfax Theatre.

Fairfax.name: Cascade Canyon & Deer Park
Fairfax.line: Cascade Drive's creekside cottages run out to the Cascade Canyon preserve; Deer Park's trails start nearby.

Fairfax.name: Fairfax Manor
Fairfax.line: Hillside streets north of downtown, climbing Manor and Scenic Roads toward the Loma Alta preserve.

San Rafael.name: Downtown & Fourth Street
San Rafael.line: Fourth Street's restaurants and the Rafael theater, with the 1817 mission and the Transit Center at its edges.

San Rafael.name: Canal District
San Rafael.line: Dense, largely Latino neighborhood along the San Rafael Canal, with Pickleweed Park and the Boro Center.

San Rafael.name: Dominican
San Rafael.line: Dominican University's wooded campus and the big old houses of the Dominican neighborhood up to Black Canyon.

San Rafael.name: Marin Civic Center
San Rafael.line: Frank Lloyd Wright's blue-roofed county center and its lagoon, with the Sunday farmers market in the lot.

San Rafael.name: Terra Linda & Northgate
San Rafael.line: Eichler tracts along Freitas Parkway, the Northgate shopping center and ridge trails above Terra Linda.

San Rafael.name: Peacock Gap
San Rafael.line: Point San Pedro Road's east-end neighborhoods around the golf course, on the way to McNears Beach and China Camp.

Lucas Valley.line: Joseph Eichler's largest Marin tract, flat-roofed and glass-walled along Idylberry and Mount Lassen Drive.

Lucas Valley.name: Big Rock
Lucas Valley.line: Lucas Valley Road's rural stretch west of the houses, past Big Rock toward the Nicasio grade and Skywalker Ranch.

Novato.name: Old Town & Grant Avenue
Novato.line: Grant Avenue's low brick storefronts, the city hall in a former church, and Tuesday-night farmers markets.

Novato.name: Hamilton
Novato.line: Spanish Revival hangars and officers' homes of the old Hamilton Air Force Base, now housing, MarinMOCA and wetlands.

Novato.name: Ignacio & Indian Valley

Novato.name: San Marin & Mount Burdell
Novato.line: Novato's northwest neighborhoods under Mount Burdell, whose oak-grassland trails start at San Andreas Drive.

San Geronimo Valley.line: The valley's biggest village: a tiny post office, Railroad Avenue cottages and the Woodacre Improvement Club pool.

San Geronimo Valley.name: San Geronimo
San Geronimo Valley.line: The former golf course, now open-space commons, beside the Valley Community Center and the Two Bird Cafe.

San Geronimo Valley.line: The westernmost village, where Sir Francis Drake enters the redwoods of Samuel P. Taylor State Park.

Muir Beach.line: The sheltered cove at Redwood Creek's mouth, the Tudor-style Pelican Inn and the Green Gulch farm road.

Bolinas.line: Wharf Road and Brighton Avenue by the lagoon channel: Smiley's Saloon, the People's Store and the beach.

Bolinas.line: The flat-topped mesa above town, a grid of unpaved lanes, horse paddocks and the Commonweal retreat.

Marin Headlands.name: Tennessee Valley

Mount Tam & Muir Woods.name: Muir Woods

Mount Tam & Muir Woods.name: Lake Lagunitas & Bon Tempe

Angel Island.name: Immigration Station
Angel Island.line: The 1910-40 detention barracks on the east shore, walls carved with Chinese poems, plus Fort McDowell.

Oakland.name: Temescal
Oakland.line: Telegraph Avenue's restaurant row around 49th Street and the Temescal Alleys' tiny shops.

Oakland.line: College Avenue under the BART tracks: Market Hall, bookstores and Craftsman side streets.

Oakland.line: Broadway from the Fox and Paramount theaters to City Hall and Old Oakland's Victorian blocks.

Oakland.line: Victorian blocks and warehouses between the port and the freeways, around Mandela Parkway and the BART station.

Oakland.name: Fruitvale

Oakland.name: Montclair

Emeryville.name: Park Avenue District

Daly City.line: Daly City's detached strip along Bayshore Boulevard, home to the 1941 Cow Palace arena.

Brisbane.name: Sierra Point & Marina

South San Francisco.name: Westborough

South San Francisco.name: El Camino & SSF BART
South San Francisco.line: The El Camino Real and Mission Road corridor around the BART station, Kaiser and the Centennial Way trail.

San Bruno.name: Downtown San Mateo Ave

San Bruno.name: Crestmoor & Skyline
San Bruno.line: Western hills of ranch houses up Sneath Lane to Skyline College, where the fog pours over Sweeney Ridge.

Millbrae.line: Broadway's Cantonese and Taiwanese restaurants, with the BART-Caltrain hub across El Camino.

Millbrae.name: Mills Estate & Green Hills
Millbrae.line: Hillside subdivisions above El Camino, around the Green Hills Country Club and Mills High School.

Millbrae.name: Millbrae Highlands

Burlingame.name: Broadway

San Mateo.name: Hillsdale & Bay Meadows
San Mateo.line: Hillsdale Shopping Center and the Bay Meadows racetrack site, rebuilt as parks and mid-rise housing.

San Mateo.name: 25th Avenue & Beresford
San Mateo.line: The 25th Avenue strip's Japanese restaurants and the Beresford neighborhood around Beresford Park.

Foster City.line: The lagoon-side park and amphitheater at Foster City's center, with the city hall and library next door.

Belmont.name: Water Dog Lake

San Carlos.line: The downtown strip of Laurel Street restaurants, the Caltrain station and Burton Park's ballfields.

Redwood City.name: Redwood Shores

Redwood City.name: Roosevelt & Woodside Rd
Redwood City.line: Woodside Road's shopping strip and the Roosevelt neighborhood's bungalows between El Camino and the hills.

Redwood City.name: Farm Hill & Canada College
Redwood City.line: Hillside homes up Farm Hill Boulevard to Canada College's ridge campus and the Edgewood Park edge.

Menlo Park.line: Menlo Park's main street from the Caltrain station: Kepler's Books, Cafe Borrone and Draeger's.

San Bruno Mountain.line: Radio towers on the 1,314-foot summit, reached by Summit Loop Trail, with rare butterflies on the grassy slopes.

San Bruno Mountain.name: The Saddle & Bog Trail
San Bruno Mountain.line: The main park entrance off Guadalupe Canyon Parkway, with the flat Bog and Saddle loops and Old Guadalupe Trail.

San Bruno Mountain.name: East Ridge
San Bruno Mountain.line: The mountain's eastern ridge, dropping to Terrabay and Hillside Boulevard above South San Francisco.
